MISS ZERO is an independent collection of 3,333 NFT avatars, inspired by retro anime and the Zero / LayerZero ecosystem.

From the shirt she wears to the thing she holds, every combination gives her a different personality. Choose the one that feels like you.

A few things to know

What makes each MISS ZERO different?

Each avatar combines a hairstyle, expression, shirt, tattoo option, background and raised-hand pose or object. The collection has 4 hairstyles, 6 expressions, 10 shirts, 5 tattoo options, 6 backgrounds and 7 hand variants.

Is MISS ZERO an official LayerZero project?

MISS ZERO is an independent collection. The Zero / LayerZero ecosystem is part of the project’s context; no official partnership has been confirmed.

Can I mint one yet?

This page introduces the collection. Mint dates, price and access details have not been announced here.
